js: (async()=>{const m=document.querySelector('[data-im="add-menu"]');m.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));document.querySelector('[data-im="add-text"]').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));const m2=document.querySelector('[data-im="add-menu"]');m2.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));document.querySelector('[data-im="add-text"]').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();return JSON.stringify(st.state.cards.filter(c=>c.kind==='text').map(c=>({id:c.id,checked:c.checked,content:c.content})))})()

(async()=>{const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const t=st.state.cards.filter(c=>c.kind==='text');const card=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+t[0].id+'"]');card.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const bar=document.querySelector('[data-im="card-toolbar"]');const btn=bar?[...bar.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='编辑'):null;if(!btn)return 'no-edit:'+JSON.stringify(bar?[...bar.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()):null);btn.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const ta=document.querySelector('[data-im="card-editor"]');const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set;setter.call(ta,'（D 独立验收）未勾选的注释文字');ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const card2=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+t[0].id+'"]');[...card2.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='完成编辑').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));return JSON.stringify({textId:t[0].id})})()
